{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates
# We keep the row with highest sample_seq (i.e., most recent test)
df = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: divide biomarker_final by 10 (since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Now check the final shape and confirm deduplication
print(f"Final dataset shape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Unique patient IDs: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Arm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())
print(f"Severity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())
print(f"Age mean: {df['age'].mean():.1f}")
print(f"Sex distribution:")
print(df['sex'].value_counts())"}
